proposals.evidence: DEDR5474 explicitly attests Kota veṭm, oblique veṭt-, mountain, alongside Kota beṭ and Tamil viṭam. Survey vēṭume preserves the distinctive v-ṭ-m sequence and mountain sense but writes a long first vowel and vowels around the final cluster; this is a qualified family proposal, not an asserted exact phonetic match.

proposals.evidence: DEDR1 explicitly gives Kota ad that thing/those things within the remote-demonstrative paradigm. Survey adʰə that preserves the same demonstrative stem with written h and final ə absent from the DEDR form. Retain those transcription differences; the target is the whole article, with no reinterpretation of its head.
